paras: Complete the look of the ADRO G8X M3/M4 V2 front bumper with the matching ADRO carbon fibre front lip.

Designed specifically for our V2 bumper, this front lip is made from real handcrafted carbon fibre and shaped to follow the bumper's updated lines and lower profile. The result is a front end that looks wider, lower, and more aggressive while still maintaining a clean, well-balanced appearance. Whether on the street or track, the ADRO V2 front lip adds both style and purpose to the front of your G8X M3 or M4.
